# Elite Bot Studios

> An engineering studio that designs, builds, and tests embedded hardware — from
> firmware to finished PCB — delivered fully remotely.

Elite Bot Studios is an embedded systems and power electronics studio based in
Rawalpindi, Pakistan, working with clients worldwide. The studio was established
in October 2026 and is run by one electrical engineering undergraduate
specialising in power. Work covers embedded firmware, PCB design in KiCad, IoT
device prototyping, and power electronics prototyping.

Engagements are delivered remotely in three stages: a fixed scope with a bill of
materials and wiring diagram; development and bench testing with progress video
at each milestone; then handover of source code, schematics, Gerbers, and setup
guides plus a live call. Typical reply time to a new enquiry is under 48 hours.

The studio publishes its builds as it works on them, including measured results
and the conditions they were measured under. Simulated or expected figures are
labelled as such. There are no client testimonials on this site, because the
studio has not yet completed client work.

## Core pages

- [Services](https://elitebotstudios.me/services.html): Embedded firmware development, PCB design in KiCad, IoT device prototyping, and power electronics prototyping — what each includes and the tools used.
- [Projects](https://elitebotstudios.me/projects.html): Documented builds with problem, approach, bill of materials, firmware, and measured results. Driven by projects.json.
- [Lab Log](https://elitebotstudios.me/lab.html): Build notes written as the work happens, including what did not go to plan.
- [About](https://elitebotstudios.me/about.html): Who runs the studio, the three working rules, and the timeline.
- [Contact](https://elitebotstudios.me/contact.html): Project brief form and direct email. Replies within 48 hours.

## Capability

- Embedded firmware: ESP32, STM32, C/C++, FreeRTOS, PlatformIO, ESP-IDF
- PCB design: KiCad, two and four layer layout, design-rule checks, Gerber and Excellon output
- IoT: Wi-Fi, BLE, MQTT, TLS, device provisioning, reconnect behaviour, local buffering
- Power electronics: buck and boost conversion, linear regulation, battery charging and protection, load switching, efficiency and thermal measurement
